description_en: Performs a paged query on the contents of a collaboration space folder
description_zh: 分页查询协作空间目录资料内容
name: ListGroupDirectory

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of a visible directory within the space. If omitted or set to root, the internal root is queried. On the first query, the existing service initialization for the root directory is used
parameters.help_zh: 空间内可见目录 ID；省略或 root 查内部根，首次查询沿用现有服务初始化根目录
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The sort field within the group. Valid values: name, gmt_create, and gmt_modified. Directories are listed first
parameters.help_zh: 组内排序字段：name、gmt_create、gmt_modified；目录优先
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order within the group. Valid values: asc and desc. Directories are always listed first
parameters.help_zh: 组内排序方向：asc 或 desc；目录始终优先
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The array of resource types. If values are specified, only resources are returned. If the array is empty or omitted, no type-based filtering is applied, and the existing resource type filtering logic is used
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型数组；有值时仅返回资源，空数组或省略不按类型筛选，沿用现有资料类型筛选逻辑
parameters.name: source_types

parameters.help_en: The resource status filter. Physical subdirectories are retained. Immediate reference directories are not returned when a status filter is set. This follows the existing behavior
parameters.help_zh: 资源状态筛选；物理子目录仍保留，直属引用目录在设置状态筛选时不返回，沿用现有行为
parameters.name: source_status

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

items.description_en: The immediate subdirectories and resources on the current page. The queried directory itself is not included, and results are not recursively expanded
items.description_zh: 当前页直属子目录与资料，不包含查询目录自身，不递归展开

creatorName.description_en: The name of the directory creator or resource submitter
creatorName.description_zh: 目录创建人或资料提交人姓名

directoryKind.description_en: The directory ownership category. This follows the service output, such as normal
directoryKind.description_zh: 目录归属分类，沿用服务输出，如 normal

directoryType.description_en: The directory type. Physical directories within the space have a value of GROUP. Reference directories retain their original type
directoryType.description_zh: 目录类型；空间物理目录为 GROUP，引用目录保留原类型

itemId.description_en: The directoryId of a directory or the sourceId of a resource
itemId.description_zh: 目录的 directoryId 或资料的 sourceId

itemType.description_en: The content type. Valid values: directory (subdirectory) and resource
itemType.description_zh: 内容类型：directory 子目录或 resource 资料

modifierName.description_en: The name of the last modifier

objectBindings.description_en: The list of resource object bindings. This may be empty if metadata is missing or for referenced resources
objectBindings.description_zh: 资源对象绑定列表，元数据缺失或引用资料可能为空

graphName.description_en: The name of the knowledge graph to which the binding belongs

objectId.description_en: The business ID of the object

objectName.description_en: The display name of the object

objectTypeName.description_en: The display name of the object type

readOnly.description_en: Indicates whether the content is a read-only reference. A value of false does not indicate write permissions. Write operations still require creator or space administrator permissions
readOnly.description_zh: 是否为只读引用内容；false 不代表具备写权限，写入仍需创建者或空间管理员权限

sourceKind.description_en: The resource ownership category. This follows the service output
sourceKind.description_zh: 资料归属分类，沿用服务输出

sourceStatus.description_en: The resource parsing status. This field has a value only for resource items
sourceStatus.description_zh: 资料解析状态，资源项有值

sourceType.description_en: The resource type. This field has a value only for resource items. The type display rules of the service are used
sourceType.description_zh: 资料类型，资源项有值；沿用服务的类型展示规则

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

totalCount.description_en: The total number of entries after filtering and before pagination. This includes both physical content and referenced content that match the filter criteria
totalCount.description_zh: 筛选后分页前总数，包含命中的物理内容与引用内容
